_source: census eq2/achievement (category=Raids, subcategory=Rise of Kunark) + live character verification (2026-09-02)
_notes: RoK raid-zone progression flags have no census-visible quest — but each tier's final boss awards a kill achievement. Character side: eq2/character achievements.achievement_list entries are {id, completed_timestamp} (per character; verified earned on a Varsoon character DURING its RoK era, so TLE servers grant them). c:show=achievements pulls the character's full 500+ entry list — project narrowly or filter server-side. A tier ticks when every achievement in it is earned. Trakanon himself is additionally gated by the access quest (see trakanon.json).

tracking.earned: achievement id present in character achievements.achievement_list

extra.note: final VP kill; the fight itself is gated by the Taking on Trakanon quest (trakanon.json)
